title: Pisa Particle Physics Journal Club
tagline: A weekly informal meeting to discuss new papers in particle physics, cosmology and related fields.

agenda.title: Talks
agenda.detail: One or two participants present a result, a paper or a work in progress (about 15 minutes each, plus questions).

agenda.title: Papers of the week
agenda.detail: A quick run through the selected papers, with their slides.

agenda.title: Draw and announcements
agenda.detail: Draw next week's speaker for a short presentation; ideas and announcements.

about: The journal club is open to students, postdocs and staff interested in high-energy physics, astroparticle physics and cosmology.

Each weekday a short digest of new arXiv papers is posted here; vote on the ones worth discussing. Every Monday a balanced selection, favouring the most voted, becomes the programme for Tuesday. At the end of each session a name is drawn among the participants who have presented least: that person gives a short presentation the following week. The Speakers page keeps count.
